correctness.rationale: For n=2 the pairwise-difference and mean-deviation formulas reduce to (b-a)/[2(a+b)]. For n=3, sum of pairwise differences is 4(x3-x1), hence G=2(ell+nu)/3. The unique above-mean or below-mean extreme sets show P=max(ell,nu). Direct rational computation gives G(A)=1/3 >7/24=G(B) and P(A)=13/48<7/24=P(B). Independently exhaustively enumerated all positive integer sorted triples sharing totals 3..16; no reversal for <16 and the only total-16 pair is (1,6,9),(3,3,10). The universal statement follows from elementary algebra, not enumeration.
